parameters.content:
## Model Router V1
Architecture V2 Phase 3 deterministic router. ACTIVE_PROVIDER is trusted workflow configuration and defaults to 'gemini'. Allowed values are 'gemini' and 'mock'. Exactly one provider executes per request; there is no retry or fallback. Select both provider workflows after import.
